pages.name: Benoni: 3.d5 g6
pages.notes: Plan 3 played ...Re8 before castling; plan 4 targeted a d6-pawn Black has not yet played; plan 2 pushed e4-e5 with the e-pawn on e2. Rewrote plans 2-4; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: 3.dxc5
pages.notes: Plan 2 recaptured twice on c5 (...Bxc5 and ...Nxc5); plan 1 wrote castling as 0-0. Rewrote both plans; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: Czech, 5.e4 Be7 6.g3
pages.notes: Plan 3 rerouted a knight Nd2-f1-e3 that does not exist. Rewrote plan 3; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: Czech, 5.e4 Be7 6.Nf3 O-O
pages.notes: Plan 4 routed a knight Nd2-f1-g3/e3 from f3 through the f1-bishop; plan 2 left out ...Ne8, which frees the f-pawn. Rewrote plans 2 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Grünfeld Defense: Three Knights Variation, Burille Variation, Reversed Tarrasch
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed d4-d5 onto Black's d5-pawn before the exchange; plan 3 called the e-file open; overview spelling. Rewrote plans 1 and 3.

pages.name: Benko Gambit Accepted
pages.notes: Plan 1 developed a g7-bishop that is not yet there; plan 3 routed ...Nf6-e8-d6. Rewrote plans 1 and 3; British spelling.

pages.name: Benko Gambit Declined: Bishop Attack
pages.notes: Overview described a pin the e7-pawn blocks; plan 1 met ...Ne4 with Bxe4, which the g5-bishop cannot play; plan 3 suggested h4 against a knight on e4. Rewrote overview and plans 1 and 3.

pages.name: Benko Gambit: 4.cxb5 a6 5.b6 d6
pages.notes: Plan 1 routed ...Na6-c7 with Black's pawn on a6. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling.

pages.name: Benko Gambit: 4.cxb5 a6 5.e3 g6
pages.notes: Overview said 5.e3 declines the pawn (White has already taken on b5); plan 1 played ...Rfb8 before castling and ...Na6-c7; plan 2 wrote castling as 0-0. Rewrote overview and plans 1-2.

pages.name: Benko Gambit: 4.Nf3 Bb7
pages.notes: Plan 1 played ...Rfb8 before castling; plan 2 told White to consolidate an extra pawn that has not been taken (reviewer finding, fixed and re-reviewed); overview said Black has sacrificed the pawn. Rewrote overview and both plans.
